svg.title: EvalRX ChartQA case study
svg.desc: EvalRX applied to Gemma-4-E2B on ChartQA: probing, statistical screening, hypotheses, held-out verification, and a validated L2 repair.
svg.text: probe freely · inspect many signals · form hypotheses
- Did it answer in the form we asked for?
- Same question five times, same answer?
- Asked to check itself, does it change?
- Did it ever produce the right answer?
Using plots to explain, statistical tests to
one row per candidate signal, extra
failure rate when the signal is high
Explore the reason behind the signals
Fix the failure with the validated repair ladder
Example: chartqa-human-1142 — Q: Work out the ratio of the bigger segment to the smaller one? A: 1.577
Transcribe every data mark as label → value
- Is a value on the wrong
Over the full held-out testing cases
45 fixed, 6 broken, gain far beyond chance (p ≪ .001)
Example case comes from the explore split; its treated output shows the
required form, not a measured held-out result.
